A Russian FPV drone operator struck a light anti-drone air defense system, identified as MAAWLR, operated by the Armed Forces of Ukraine and produced by the American company Sierra Nevada Corp.
The MAAWLR system is mounted on a pickup truck chassis and is equipped with an electro-optical targeting system for autonomous target detection, while also being capable of receiving external target designation from radar assets. It can use a range of missiles, including AIM-9M, AIM-132 ASRAAM, AIM-120 AMRAAM, IRIS-T, R-27, and APKWS II.
Depending on the munition used, the system is assessed to be capable of engaging drones at ranges of approximately 6–15 km.

— Iran has successfully installed the P4 processing platform at the Reshadat Oil Field, one of the country's largest offshore oil-processing platforms, weighing approximately 6,200 tons, according to IRNA.
➡️
The project—previously delayed by sanctions—was completed using a complex float-over installation method. Iranian officials said the platform was fully designed, engineered, constructed, and installed by domestic specialists without foreign assistance.
➡️
The new platform is expected to increase oil production capacity by 35,000 barrels per day and enable the injection of 80,000 barrels of water per day to maintain reservoir pressure and support field development.
➡️
Located about 90 kilometers from Lavan Island, the Reshadat field has been producing oil since 1969. Iranian authorities described the installation of the P4 platform as a major milestone in expanding offshore production capacity and advancing development of one of the Persian Gulf's key oil fields.
